rawFindings.title: Nested proxy setter no longer updates through the owning document
rawFindings.explanation: Nested object getters in `define()` return proxy objects created with `Object.create(this)` and keep the real owning document in `$__.scope`. Calling `this.set()` here uses that proxy as the `Document#set` receiver. For nested assignments on embedded documents (for example a document-array subdocument), dirty-path propagation can be computed from the proxy rather than the actual subdocument, so the parent document may not persist the change.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore setting through the owning scope: `return (this.$__.scope || this).set(path, v);`.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: With a schema containing `ratings: [{ description: { source: { url: String, time: Date } } }]`, after loading a saved movie, running `movie.ratings[0].description.source = { url: 'http://www.lifeofpimovie.com/' }; movie.save(...)` and reloading can leave `description.source.url` unchanged because the parent document was not dirtied correctly.
